headline: South Korea deploys drones to warn farmers amid deadly heat
summary: Provinces are flying loudspeaker drones over fields and rolling out cooling trucks as a heatwave claims lives and pushes farmland to 60°C.
script: South Korea is fighting a deadly heatwave with drones that warn farmers to stop working in the fields. Provinces are also sending chilled water trucks to farming areas, as temperatures soar and heat-related deaths mount across the country.
imageAlt: People cool off in the Cheonggyecheon stream in Seoul during a heatwave.
imageAltTwo: Farm workers harvest crops under shade umbrellas in extreme heat.

sources.title: South Korea province deploys drones to warn elderly farmers amid heatwave
